subject: Ciências
description_pt: Propor o uso de diferentes materiais para a construção de objetos de uso cotidiano, tendo em vista algumas propriedades desses materiais (flexibilidade, dureza, transparência etc.).

components.description_pt: Descrever e classificar matéria usando propriedades observáveis como cor, textura, dureza e flexibilidade
components.description_en: Describe and classify matter using observable properties such as color, texture, hardness, and flexibility
components.cc_component_description: Describe and classify matter using observable properties such as color, texture, hardness, and flexibility

components.description_pt: Selecionar materiais apropriados para um design baseado em suas propriedades físicas e uso pretendido
components.description_en: Select appropriate materials for a design based on their physical properties and intended use
components.cc_component_description: Select appropriate materials for a design based on their physical properties and intended use

components.description_pt: Justificar a escolha de material para um objeto dado ligando suas propriedades à função do objeto
components.description_en: Justify the choice of material for a given object by linking its properties to the object's function
components.cc_component_description: Match specific material properties to the intended purposes they are best suited to serve

cc_matches.description: Different kinds of matter exist and many of them can be either solid or liquid, depending on temperature. Matter can be described and classified by its observable properties.
Structures can be designed to serve particular functions by taking into account properties of different materials, and how materials can be shaped and used.
Different properties are suited to different purposes.
